name: Next Event Estimation for Volumetric Path Tracing
aliases: Volumetric Path Tracing with Next Event Estimation
definition: An optimization that adds next event estimation (NEE) to volumetric path tracing by sampling points on light sources and tracing shadow rays through volumes and index-matched surfaces to account for direct lighting.
summary: Next Event Estimation for Volumetric Path Tracing is an optimization that estimates direct illumination by explicitly sampling light sources and tracing shadow rays through participating media and index-matched surfaces.
